exposure: maternal IVIG treatment (1 g/kg/bw every week)
cohort: Pregnant women with a history of fetal and neonatal alloimmune thrombocytopenia (FNAIT) and an antigen-positive fetus.
finding: Maternal IVIG treatment, alongside non-invasive fetal risk determination, resulted in higher neonatal platelet counts and no intracranial hemorrhage, with only moderate maternal side effects, compared to previous index pregnancies.
